text: Employees must not disclose or share any personal plans, schedules, financial information, relationship details, or other sensitive personal data in any communication or documentation to prevent exposure of confidential information.

All sensitive political information—including strategies, communications, personal connections, negotiations, and non-public coordination—must be kept confidential and never disclosed to unauthorized individuals to prevent exposure and protect political integrity.

All sensitive internal information, including communications, strategies, personnel details, financial data, and operational plans, must be strictly protected. Access and disclosure are permitted only to authorized employees on a need-to-know basis. Unauthorized sharing, publishing, or external transmission of any internal information is strictly prohibited to prevent exposure and protect company confidentiality.
All internal media strategies, plans, schedules, contracts, and communications are classified as confidential and must not be disclosed to unauthorized persons or external parties.

All non-public and confidential information—including legal, financial, strategic, employee, and communication details—must be protected from unauthorized access or disclosure to prevent exposure of sensitive organizational information.

All internal schedules, meeting details, travel plans, and related confidential information must be protected from unauthorized disclosure to prevent exposure of sensitive operational and personal data.

All employees and partners must strictly prohibit the unauthorized disclosure or sharing of sensitive business information, including but not limited to confidential agreements, partnerships, negotiations, internal data, staffing plans, and restricted meeting content, to protect organizational integrity and maintain trust.

All employees must protect sensitive internal information related to workplace behavior, conflicts, personnel interactions, and confidential operations by refraining from unauthorized disclosure to ensure the privacy and security of the organization and its members.

All employees must not disclose or share any sensitive employment, location, identification, or personnel information, including job titles, work locations, personal contact details, and internal role assignments, to unauthorized individuals or external parties to protect privacy and maintain corporate confidentiality.
